first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, while prior evidence indicates that shorter onboarding and simpler signup sustainably improved completion, time-to-value, and activation. Promotional pricing addresses competitive pressure but carries a documented 30-day retention penalty, conflicting with the long-term qualified-revenue objective. Verify the two most directly relevant onboarding records before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow. The confirmed prior test directly addresses both current declines, improving completion by 13%, reducing time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increasing 30-day retention by 3%. SMB signup simplification provides supporting evidence for activation and qualified-revenue gains, but its 1% retention decline and limited segment replication warrant retention guardrails and no assumption of cross-segment impact.
